article.title: Kochava推出AIM Essentials，利用歷史資料分析媒體組合
article.title_en: Kochava launches AIM Essentials for media mix analysis using historical data
article.summary: 新方案以逐日事件及媒體支出資料建立行銷組合模型，供團隊檢視預算配置。
article.summary_en: The offering uses daily events and media spend to model the marketing mix and inform budget planning.
highlights: 公司描述的資料範圍是一至兩年。
輸出包括支出反應曲線及投資建議摘要。
highlights_en: The company describes one to two years of daily data inputs.
Outputs include spend-response curves and investment briefs.
article.why: 品牌可用模型提出預算調整假設，再以實驗檢查個別渠道的增量。
article.why_en: Brands can use model estimates to propose budget changes and validate channel incrementality with tests.
article.next_step: 先整理每日媒體支出和業務事件，確認促銷、缺貨及追蹤變動有紀錄。
article.next_step_en: Gather daily media spend and business events, including promotions, stockouts and tracking changes.
article.detail: 行銷組合模型用歷史支出與業務事件估算不同媒體的關聯，供團隊比較預算情境。Kochava稱Essentials已全球開放，較複雜的資料整合與多地區分析另有企業方案。採用前可檢查資料缺口及促銷影響，並要求供應商說明模型假設、估算區間和可用於驗證的實驗設計。
article.detail_en: Marketing mix models use historical spend and business events to compare budget scenarios. Kochava says Essentials is available worldwide and offers a separate enterprise tier for complex integrations and multi-geo analysis. Check data gaps and promotions, and ask for assumptions, uncertainty ranges and a validation design.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
